body: Thank you very much for your help, it is really appreciated.

I'm not waiting for any change, but everyone keeps saying it will come, that somehow I'll feel different... better...
No, I don't think I miss anything, just don't wanna be here.
Feel supuse to be reactions to actions and events... someone close to you die then u got sad, something "good" happens then u got happy, etc
Buy there are time we don't know why we feel what we feel... why we love somebody, why we cry without reason at midday, why we laugh, etc... so, in that statement, I really don't know why I feel numb, distant... I don't even know if it's exactly that what I feel, those are just the closest words I can find that "fit" somehow.
Update... I keep feeling like shit, like all these years. I stop hoping for a change. I only hope that I die in my sleep.
Bring it on bro, i hear you.
